description: Fix the most recent commit — its message, its staged content, or both — with hard guardrails against rewriting history that has already been shared. Trigger on "undo my last commit", "fix the commit message", "I forgot a file in my last commit", "reword the last commit", "amend that". Checks whether the commit has been pushed before touching anything, and refuses to quietly force-push over a shared branch. Only for commits that are still local or on your own unshared branch — once a commit is merged or others have pulled it, use revert-change-safely instead.
